title: Refund SLA Auto-Approval & Dual-Control Escalation Engine
required_invariants: Refund requests with non-positive amount or negative elapsed_hours must raise ValueError.
Auto-approval is allowed only when amount_cents <= 50000 and elapsed_hours <= 72 and not is_chargeback.
Chargeback disputes or refunds exceeding 50000 cents must route to dual_control_review.
Evaluating the same refund payload twice must be idempotent and deterministic.
